skill.summary: WebAssembly sandboxed file system operations for secure file read/write within explicitly declared directories. Use when needing to read, write, append, copy...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of boxed-fs providing secure, sandboxed file system operations via WASM.

- Supports file read, write, append, copy, and remove within user-declared directories.
- All operations run inside a WebAssembly sandbox with access controls.
- Includes atomic write, directory creation, and file/directory listing.
- Detailed usage and commands documented in SKILL.md.
